notes: One canonical row per research observation with an exact next-bar entry candle; delivered signals use source=alert.
Observations without the exact entry bar are excluded rather than simulated with a later bar.
Every path begins at the next tradable five-minute bar at detected_at; grid entries use that bar open.
The edge grid contains preregistered fat-tail and ladder exits; incomplete horizons remain unresolved.
Both exit grids are derived from snapshot.csv, paths.csv.gz, and the TypeScript simulator and can be regenerated from paths.
Controls are eligible non-signal candles from the selected-pair universe.
Wallet addresses, Telegram identity, and credentials are never exported.
